title: CISA Adds Five Known Exploited Vulnerabilities to Catalog
summary: CISA has added five new vulnerabilities to its Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) Catalog , based on evidence of active exploitation. CVE(s) Apple Multiple Products Buffer Overflow Vulnerability CVE(s) Craft CMS Code Injection Vulnerability CVE(s) Apple Multiple Products Improper Locking Vulnerability CVE(s) Apple Multiple Products Classic Buffer Overflow Vulnerability CVE(s) Laravel Livewire Code Injection Vulnerability These types of vulnerabilities are frequent attack vectors for malicious cyber actors and pose significant risks to the federal enterprise.

title: Russian Intelligence Services Target Commercial Messaging Application Accounts
summary: CISA and the Federal Bureau of Investigation released a Public Service Announcement (PSA) warning about ongoing phishing campaigns by cyber actors associated with the Russian Intelligence Services targeting commercial messaging applications (CMAs).
